verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own docs say published apps deploy to Figma's hosted infrastructure, and that you can also assign a custom domain that you own. That directly covers connecting a custom domain to a published app, though it rests on a single brief mention. Missing for 10: setup details such as DNS records, verification steps and SSL handling, any plan or tier requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect a custom domain to my published app

citations.quote: You can also assign a custom domain that you own.
Publishing deploys your app and its Payload backend to Figma’s hosted infrastructure.
